what_changed: Board and CFPB raise the Consumer Leasing Act/Regulation M exempt-lease threshold (12 CFR 1013.2(e)(1); comment 2(e) in Supplement I to Part 1013, and 12 CFR 213.2(e) for the Board) from $69,500 to $71,900 for 2025 by the annual CPI-W adjustment.
rationale: Full text confirms an inflation adjustment to consumer lease coverage; leases are not consumer loans, the register has no Regulation M row, and no servicing conduct changes.
